{{Quote|Kyle, I need you to look at the Valley of the Jedi...|Luke Skywalker to Kyle Katarn|<ref name="Academy" />}}
The '''mission''' to the [[Valley of the Jedi]] on [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]] was carried out by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kyle Katarn]] during the [[Disciples of Ragnos crisis]] in [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]].<ref name="Academy" />

Jedi Master [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] sent several [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to places where he felt a strong connection to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], after [[Alora (Dark Jedi)|Alora]] sliced into his records. The objective of the mission was to investigate cult presence on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. He directed Master Katarn to carry out the investigations of Ruusan's [[Valley of the Jedi]].<ref name="Academy" />
